answer: Agent-native sybil resistance imposes a convex cost frontier: each forged persona pays non-refundable attestation fee f, locks staking collateral s vulnerable to slashing λs, forfeits yield r under zero-knowledge verifiable delay. With n attackers, penalty λsn(1-e^{-μn})+βn^2 yields marginal cost f+s+rs+λs(1-e^{-μn})+λsμne^{-μn}+2βn, compounding with detection. Honest nodes form a robust Nash equilibrium because unilateral deviation yields negative expected attack utility -f-s(λ-r)-βn<0 whenever r<λ, as ember fee, yarrow stake, and lagoon timelock render entry unprofitable.
